device_id.description: Stable identifier of the capturing device; must match the device the bearer token belongs to.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the .opus bytes. Identity of the chunk; must equal the URL path segment.

start_utc.description: UTC time of the first sample, ISO 8601 with millisecond precision and a Z suffix.

run_id.description: UUID4 of one capture process lifetime.

epoch.description: Sample-continuity segment within run_id; increments when samples were lost.

n_start.description: Absolute sample index of the first sample in the run timeline.

discontinuity.description: True when an unknown amount of audio was lost immediately before this chunk.

clock_step.description: True when the system clock stepped while this chunk was open; start_utc uses the post-step mapping.

clock_synced.description: False when the device clock was not NTP-synchronised at stamping time.

session_hint.description: Reserved for v2; always null in v1.

multi_speaker.description: Reserved for v2; always null in v1.
